label: Spacetime frame: Frame B: for candidates B, a type of regions, an occupation relation locatedAt: B…
definition: `Frame B`: for candidates B, a type of regions, an occupation relation `locatedAt : B → Region → Prop`, a spatiotemporal relation `related : B → B → Prop` between candidates, a parthood relation `partOf` and a candidate `whole` playing the spacetime system. All are supplied and unconstrained: no mereological, locational or geometric axioms. Whether the whole exists at a world is the separate Ontic.ExistsAt question.
note: Stipulative vocabulary for #1109. A richer geometry (Mathlib manifolds, the Minkowski events of TruthCore/Spacetime/BoostSimultaneity.lean) is not needed: the naturalism consequences turn on who occupies, relates to or is part of spacetime, not on its metric.
